name: Phantom Atlas
description: Trained on a corpus of maps. Produces hallucinated cartography — coastlines, terrain and roads for places that do not exist. Melts into nonsense geography at high ψ.
provenance: MapDreamer, trained by Topi Tjukanov on map imagery using NVIDIA StyleGAN2 (config-f, legacy TF checkpoint converted with legacy.py). License unknown — treat as non-commercial. https://medium.com/@tjukanov/mapdreamer-ai-cartography-4f2f6a40ef55
